title: Detachment H U-2 at T'ao-yuan Airfield, Taiwan
description: Black-and-white photograph of a U-2 parked on an airfield with ground crew, a support vehicle and several people walking nearby. Captioned "Detachment H U-2 at T'ao-yuan Airfield." Chapter 5 text (page 225) explains that Nationalist Chinese pilots and aircraft were known as Detachment H, based at T'ao-yuan, and discusses 1961 deliberations over PRC overflights.
